redBlue.title: Red Team vs. Blue Team (Exploit & Patch)
redBlue.subtitle: Direct comparison between an exploited BOLA/IDOR HTTP request and the architectural remediation in NestJS + Prisma ORM.
redBlue.patchTitle: Architectural Remediation in NestJS + Prisma ORM (Zero-Trust Query)
redBlue.redDescription: An attacker swaps the order UUID on GET /api/v1/orders/:id using their own valid JWT. Because the backend queries only by primary key without checking ownerId, sensitive data and third-party S3 URLs leak.
redBlue.blueDescription: The patch enforces ownership scoping directly in Prisma's WHERE clause using the authenticated JWT subject, alongside strict UUID Pipe validation and audit logging.
